notes: Selected probabilities are estimates, not achieved accuracy. This snapshot does not refresh when opened.
All completed 2026 games select ordinary spread and total policies; these results are exposed retrospective validation.

Point projections are model location estimates, not the expected values of the residual distributions.
Book option probabilities are unconditional win/push/loss. Card side probabilities condition on no push.
Observed prices are snapshots. Modeled quote returns exclude fees, spread, liquidity and execution risk.
